posts.text: Stock to buy - BAJAJ MOBILITY > BAJAJ AUTO. (High risk, High Reward) Austria Has very funny laws. Where DEBT can be written off upto 70% with 0% Equity Dilution…In Bankruptcies THIS is what happened at Pierer Mobility AG (NOW BAJAJ MOBILITY AG) 70% OF DEBT WAS WIPED OFF. Remaining 30% was taken over by BAJAJ (Most of it has since been refinanced at much lower rates) + Some working capital Loans by BAJAJ.
